properties.name: management.endpoint.health.access
properties.description: Permitted level of access for the health endpoint.

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.cache.time-to-live
properties.description: Maximum time that a response can be cached.

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.group
properties.description: Health endpoint groups.

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.logging.slow-indicator-threshold
properties.description: Threshold after which a warning will be logged for slow health indicators.

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.probes.add-additional-paths
properties.description: Whether to make the liveness and readiness health groups available on the main server port.

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.probes.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable liveness and readiness probes.

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.roles
properties.description: Roles used to determine whether a user is authorized to be shown details. When empty, all authenticated users are authorized.

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.show-components
properties.description: When to show components. If not specified the 'show-details' setting will be used.

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.show-details
properties.description: When to show full health details.

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.status.http-mapping
properties.description: Mapping of health statuses to HTTP status codes. By default, registered health statuses map to sensible defaults (for example, UP maps to 200).

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.status.order
properties.description: List of health statuses in order of severity.

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.validate-group-membership
properties.description: Whether to validate health group membership on startup. Validation fails if a group includes or excludes a health contributor that does not exist.

properties.name: management.health.defaults.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable default health indicators.

properties.name: management.health.diskspace.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable disk space health check.

properties.name: management.health.diskspace.path
properties.description: Path used to compute the available disk space.

properties.name: management.health.diskspace.threshold
properties.description: Minimum disk space that should be available.

properties.name: management.health.livenessstate.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable liveness state health check.

properties.name: management.health.ping.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable ping health check.

properties.name: management.health.readinessstate.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable readiness state health check.

properties.name: management.health.ssl.certificate-validity-warning-threshold
properties.description: If an SSL Certificate will be invalid within the time span defined by this threshold, it should trigger a warning.

properties.name: management.health.ssl.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable SSL certificate health check.

properties.name: management.health.probes.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable liveness and readiness probes.
